mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% YoY signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises.
